"""RoboPaint lettering controller, eai-standard/2.2.
Run with --phase dip, practice, or write. Target pixel coordinates are mapped through
spec.static.target_image to the main sheet's calibrated world plane.
"""
import sys, math, json, argparse, pathlib, time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, '/opt/tools')
from rcb_client import Robot

Q_DOWN = np.array([0., 1., 0., 0.])
PAPER_Z = 0.020
LIGHT_Z = PAPER_Z - 0.0004
PRESSED_Z = PAPER_Z - 0.0018
MM = 0.00022186


def add_segment(rows, a, b, step=0.005, q0=Q_DOWN, q1=None):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); b=np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
    if q1 is None: q1=q0
    q0=np.asarray(q0,dtype=float); q1=np.asarray(q1,dtype=float)
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step)))
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=i/n
        q=(1-t)*q0+t*q1; q/=np.linalg.norm(q)
        rows.append(np.r_[(1-t)*a+t*b,q])


def add_dwell(rows, p, seconds=0.25, q=Q_DOWN):
    for _ in range(max(1,int(round(seconds*20)))): rows.append(np.r_[p,q])


def run_rows(r, rows, note, cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='both', fps=10):
    arr=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)
    out=[]
    # <= 200 rows = <=10s at 20Hz; preserve contact and interpolation across chunks.
    for i in range(0,len(arr),190):
        part=arr[i:i+190]
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',part,dt=0.05,cameras=list(cameras),video=video,video_fps=fps,note=note)
        out.append(res)
        print(json.dumps({'chunk':len(out),'rows':len(part),'executed':res.meta.get('executed_rows'),
                          'stopped':res.stopped,'plan':res.meta.get('plan',[])[:4],
                          'now':res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[None]*14)[7:14]}))
        pathlib.Path('/app/runs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        res.save(f'/app/runs/{note}_{len(out):02d}')
    print('status',json.dumps(r.status()))
    return out


def target_world(u,v,z):
    # The calibrated canvas camera centre is the main sheet centre (-0.1,0).
    # Main sheet coordinates: X rightward in exemplar -> world -y; Y toward robot -> world -x.
    X=(u+0.5)*0.227185/1024
    Y=(v+0.5)*0.227185/1024
    return np.array([-0.1 + 0.1135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, z])


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--phase',default='dip',choices=['dip','practice','write','status'])
    args=ap.parse_args(); r=Robot(); print('status',json.dumps(r.status()))
    obs=r.get_obs(video='none'); now=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float)
    start=now[:3]; q=now[3:7]; print('tip',now.tolist())
    if args.phase=='status': return
    if args.phase=='dip':
        rows=[]; above=np.array([-.100,.151,.105]); dip=np.array([-.100,.151,.024])
        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,dip,step=.003)
        add_dwell(rows,dip,.6)
        add_segment(rows,dip,above,step=.003)
        run_rows(r,rows,'dip',cameras=('scene_cam','side_cam'),video='both')
    elif args.phase=='practice':

        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,contact,step=.003)
        # A diagonal test line with a mild press, on the practice sheet only.
        end=np.array([-.145,-.151,.0185])
        add_segment(rows,contact,end,step=.003)
        add_dwell(rows,end,.1)
        add_segment(rows,end,np.array([end[0],end[1],.105]),step=.004)
        run_rows(r,rows,'practice',cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam','scene_cam'),video='both')

PAPER_Z = 0.020
MM_PER_PX = 0.227185 / 1024.0


def add_segment(rows, a, b, step=0.005, q0=Q_DOWN, q1=None):
    a=np.asarray(a,dtype=float); b=np.asarray(b,dtype=float)
    if q1 is None: q1=q0
    q0=np.asarray(q0,dtype=float); q1=np.asarray(q1,dtype=float)
    n=max(1,int(math.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/step)))
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        t=i/n
        q=(1-t)*q0+t*q1; q/=np.linalg.norm(q)
        rows.append(np.r_[(1-t)*a+t*b,q])


def add_dwell(rows, p, seconds=0.25, q=Q_DOWN):
    for _ in range(max(1,int(round(seconds*20)))): rows.append(np.r_[p,q])


def run_rows(r, rows, note, cameras=('canvas_cam','scene_cam','side_cam'), video='both', fps=10):
    arr=np.asarray(rows,dtype=np.float32)
    out=[]
    # <= 190 rows = 9.5s at 20Hz; each submit preserves contact between chunks.
    for i in range(0,len(arr),190):
        part=arr[i:i+190]
        res=r.submit('ee_pose',part,dt=0.05,cameras=list(cameras),video=video,video_fps=fps,note=note)
        out.append(res)
        current=np.asarray(res.meta.get('proprio',{}).get('now',[0]*14)[7:14],float)
        print(json.dumps({'chunk':len(out),'rows':len(part),'executed':res.meta.get('executed_rows'),
                          'stopped':res.stopped,'ik_failures':sum(int(x.get('ik_failures',0)) for x in res.meta.get('plan',[])),
                          'time_left_s':res.meta.get('time_left_s'),'tip':current.tolist()}),flush=True)
        pathlib.Path('/app/runs').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        res.save(f'/app/runs/{note}_{len(out):02d}')
    print('status',json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
    return out


def target_world(u,v,z):
    # The calibrated canvas camera center is the main sheet center (-0.1, 0).
    # Image columns advance toward the robot's right (-world y); rows toward the robot (-world x).
    X=(u+0.5)*0.227185/1024
    Y=(v+0.5)*0.227185/1024
    return np.array([-0.1 + 0.1135925 - Y, 0.1135925 - X, z])


def thin_zhang_suen(mask):
    s=np.asarray(mask,dtype=bool).copy(); changed=True; it=0
    while changed and it<100:
        changed=False; it+=1
        for phase in (0,1):
            p=np.pad(s,1)
            P2=p[:-2,1:-1]; P3=p[:-2,2:]; P4=p[1:-1,2:]; P5=p[2:,2:]
            P6=p[2:,1:-1]; P7=p[2:,:-2]; P8=p[1:-1,:-2]; P9=p[:-2,:-2]
            ns=[P2,P3,P4,P5,P6,P7,P8,P9]; n=sum(ns)
            trans=sum((ns[i]==0)&(ns[(i+1)%8]==1) for i in range(8))
            if phase==0: cond=(P2*P4*P6==0)&(P4*P6*P8==0)
            else: cond=(P2*P4*P8==0)&(P2*P6*P8==0)
            remove=(s==1)&(n>=2)&(n<=6)&(trans==1)&cond
            if remove.any(): s[remove]=0; changed=True
    return s


def target_route(step_px=3.0):
    image=np.asarray(Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('L'))
    mask=image<150
    skel=thin_zhang_suen(mask)
    labels,nlab=ndi.label(skel,structure=np.ones((3,3),dtype=np.uint8))
    counts=np.bincount(labels.ravel()); counts[0]=0
    main_label=int(np.argmax(counts)); main=(labels==main_label)
    coords=[tuple(x) for x in np.argwhere(main)]
    points=set(coords); adj={}
    for y,x in coords:
        ns=[]
        for dy in (-1,0,1):
            for dx in (-1,0,1):
                if dy==dx==0: continue
                q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                if q not in points: continue
                # Do not add a diagonal shortcut when the same two pixels are joined orthogonally.
                if dy and dx and ((y,x+dx) in points or (y+dy,x) in points): continue
                ns.append(q)
        adj[(y,x)]=ns
    ends=[p for p in coords if len(adj[p])==1]
    if not ends: raise RuntimeError('target skeleton has no endpoint')
    root=min(ends,key=lambda p:(p[1],abs(p[0]-532)))
    visited=set(); used=set(); route=[root]
    sys.setrecursionlimit(10000)
    def visit(p, parent=None):
        incoming=None if parent is None else np.asarray(p,dtype=float)-np.asarray(parent,dtype=float)
        cand=[]
        for q in adj[p]:
            key=tuple(sorted((p,q)))
            if key in used: continue
            d=np.asarray(q,dtype=float)-np.asarray(p,dtype=float)
            turn=0.0 if incoming is None else abs(math.atan2(incoming[0]*d[1]-incoming[1]*d[0],float(np.dot(incoming,d))))
            cand.append((turn,q,key))
        cand.sort(key=lambda v:v[0])
        visited.add(p)
        for _,q,key in cand:
            if key in used: continue
            used.add(key); route.append(q)
            if q not in visited: visit(q,p)
            route.append(p)
    visit(root)
    total_edges=sum(len(v) for v in adj.values())//2
    if len(visited)!=len(points) or len(used)!=total_edges:
        raise RuntimeError(f'incomplete skeleton walk: vertices {len(visited)}/{len(points)}, edges {len(used)}/{total_edges}')
    coords=np.asarray(route,dtype=float)
    seg=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(coords,axis=0),axis=1)
    cum=np.r_[0.,np.cumsum(seg)]
    sample_d=np.arange(0.,cum[-1],step_px)
    if len(sample_d)==0 or sample_d[-1]<cum[-1]: sample_d=np.r_[sample_d,cum[-1]]
    sample=np.column_stack([np.interp(sample_d,cum,coords[:,k]) for k in (0,1)])
    dist=ndi.distance_transform_edt(mask)
    radius=[]
    for y,x in sample:
        iy=int(np.clip(round(y),0,1023)); ix=int(np.clip(round(x),0,1023))
        radius.append(float(dist[iy,ix]))
    widths=np.clip(2*np.asarray(radius)*MM_PER_PX*1000.,0.4,2.0)
    widths=ndi.median_filter(widths,size=3,mode='nearest')
    poses=[]; yaws=[]; previous=None
    for i,(y,x) in enumerate(sample):
        lo=max(0,i-2); hi=min(len(sample)-1,i+2)
        dy_pix=sample[hi,0]-sample[lo,0]; dx_pix=sample[hi,1]-sample[lo,1]
        # Pixel (u,v) maps to world tangent (dx,dy)=(-dv,-du).
        tangent=np.array([-dy_pix,-dx_pix],dtype=float); norm=np.linalg.norm(tangent)
        if norm<1e-8:
            tangent=np.array([- (sample[min(i+1,len(sample)-1),0]-y),
                              - (sample[min(i+1,len(sample)-1),1]-x)])
            norm=max(1e-8,np.linalg.norm(tangent))
        tangent/=norm; normal=np.array([-tangent[1],tangent[0]])
        w=float(widths[i])
        depth_mm=max(1.5,(w-0.4)/0.4)
        depth_mm=min(depth_mm,4.0)
        across=float(np.clip((w-0.4)/(0.4*depth_mm),0.,1.))
        alpha=math.asin(across)
        axis=math.cos(alpha)*tangent+math.sin(alpha)*normal
        theta=math.atan2(-axis[0],-axis[1])
        if previous is not None:
            while theta-previous>math.pi/2: theta-=math.pi
            while theta-previous<-math.pi/2: theta+=math.pi
        previous=theta; yaws.append(theta)
        q=np.array([0.,math.sin(theta/2),-math.cos(theta/2),0.])
        if poses and np.dot(q,poses[-1][3:])<0: q=-q
        z=PAPER_Z-depth_mm/1000.
        xyz=target_world(x,y,z)
        poses.append(np.r_[xyz,q])
    return np.asarray(poses),sample,widths,np.asarray(yaws),len(points),total_edges,cum[-1]


def make_dot_rows(rows, current_contact, current_q, center_uv):
    # The exemplar's dot diameter is about 2 mm. A 1.2 mm pressure line swept around
    # a 0.3 mm radius makes one compact round contact.
    cx,cy=center_uv; r_mm=0.30; depth_mm=2.0
    above0=target_world(cx+r_mm/MM_PER_PX,cy,PAPER_Z+0.085)
    contact0=target_world(cx+r_mm/MM_PER_PX,cy,PAPER_Z-depth_mm/1000.)
    q_dot=np.array([0.,2**-0.5,-2**-0.5,0.])
    add_segment(rows,current_contact, np.r_[current_contact[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],step=.004,q0=current_q)
    above_start=np.r_[above0,q_dot]
    add_segment(rows,np.r_[current_contact[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],above0,step=.004,q0=current_q,q1=q_dot)
    add_segment(rows,above0,contact0,step=.002,q0=q_dot)
    # Sweep a small circle; nib orientation follows the tangent so its tines spread across it.
    count=20
    for j in range(1,count+1):
        a=2*math.pi*j/count
        u=cx+(r_mm/MM_PER_PX)*math.cos(a); v=cy+(r_mm/MM_PER_PX)*math.sin(a)
        tangent=np.array([-math.sin(a),math.cos(a)]) # pixel-space tangent convention is handled by mapping below
        # For the tiny symmetric dot, keep the across orientation fixed; rotation is unnecessary.
        rows.append(np.r_[target_world(u,v,PAPER_Z-depth_mm/1000.),q_dot])
    contact_end=target_world(cx+r_mm/MM_PER_PX,cy,PAPER_Z-depth_mm/1000.)
    add_segment(rows,contact_end,np.r_[contact_end[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],step=.002,q0=q_dot)
    return np.r_[contact_end[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],q_dot


def build_write_rows(r, start, q_start, step_px=3.0):
    poses,sample,widths,yaws,npix,nedges,walk_px=target_route(step_px)
    print(json.dumps({'skeleton_pixels':npix,'skeleton_edges':nedges,'walk_px':round(float(walk_px),1),
                      'trajectory_rows':len(poses),'width_mm_min_max':[round(float(widths.min()),3),round(float(widths.max()),3)],
                      'first_pixel_rc':sample[0].tolist(),'last_pixel_rc':sample[-1].tolist()}),flush=True)
    rows=[]
    first=poses[0]; above=np.r_[first[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085]
    add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q_start,q1=first[3:])
    add_segment(rows,above,first[:3],step=.002,q0=first[3:])
    rows.extend(poses[1:].tolist())
    current=poses[-1,:3].copy(); cq=poses[-1,3:].copy()
    # Raise, then draw each exemplar dot as its own small continuous contact.
    for dot in ((334.33,489.14),(494.01,489.12)):
        center=target_world(*dot,PAPER_Z+0.085)
        add_segment(rows,current,np.r_[current[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],step=.003,q0=cq)
        add_segment(rows,np.r_[current[:2],PAPER_Z+0.085],center,step=.005,q0=cq,q1=Q_DOWN)
        current,cq=make_dot_rows(rows,center,Q_DOWN,dot)
    # Retract beyond the left edge of the scored sheet so the final canvas image is clear.
    exit_pose=np.array([-.10,.17,.20])
    add_segment(rows,current,exit_pose,step=.005,q0=cq,q1=Q_DOWN)
    return rows,(poses,sample,widths)


def save_path_preview(data):
    poses,sample,widths=data
    im=Image.open('/app/target.png').convert('RGB')
    d=ImageDraw.Draw(im)
    for i in range(1,len(sample)):
        y0,x0=sample[i-1]; y1,x1=sample[i]
        # Draw the predicted footprint in red over the exemplar for visual review.
        w=max(1,int(round((widths[i-1]+widths[i])*0.5/MM_PER_PX)))
        d.line((x0,y0,x1,y1),fill=(255,40,40),width=w)
    im.save('/app/output/path_preview.png')


def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--phase',default='status',choices=['dip','practice','pressure','pressurewide','plan','write','status'])
    args=ap.parse_args(); r=Robot(); print('status',json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
    obs=r.get_obs(video='none'); now=np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][7:14],float)
    start=now[:3]; q=now[3:7]; print('tip',now.tolist(),flush=True)
    if args.phase=='status': return
    if args.phase=='dip':
        rows=[]; above=np.array([-.100,.151,.105]); dip=np.array([-.100,.151,.024])
        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,dip,step=.003)
        add_dwell(rows,dip,.6)
        add_segment(rows,dip,above,step=.003)
        run_rows(r,rows,'dip',cameras=('scene_cam','side_cam'),video='both')
    elif args.phase=='practice':
        rows=[]; above=np.array([-.080,-.224,.105]); contact=np.array([-.080,-.224,.0185])
        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,contact,step=.003)
        end=np.array([-.145,-.151,.0185])
        add_segment(rows,contact,end,step=.003)
        add_dwell(rows,end,.1)
        add_segment(rows,end,np.array([end[0],end[1],.105]),step=.004)
        run_rows(r,rows,'practice',cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam','scene_cam'),video='both')
    elif args.phase=='pressure':
        rows=[]; above=np.array([-.020,-.232,.105]); contact=np.array([-.020,-.232,.016])
        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,contact,step=.003)
        end=np.array([-.020,-.140,.016])
        add_segment(rows,contact,end,step=.003)
        add_segment(rows,end,np.array([end[0],end[1],.105]),step=.004)
        run_rows(r,rows,'pressure',cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'),video='both')
    elif args.phase=='pressurewide':
        rows=[]; qwide=np.array([0.,2**-.5,-2**-.5,0.]); above=np.array([-.060,-.232,.105]); contact=np.array([-.060,-.232,.016])
        add_segment(rows,start,above,step=.005,q0=q)
        add_segment(rows,above,contact,step=.003,q0=Q_DOWN,q1=qwide)
        end=np.array([-.060,-.140,.016])
        add_segment(rows,contact,end,step=.003,q0=qwide)
        add_segment(rows,end,np.array([end[0],end[1],.105]),step=.004,q0=qwide)
        run_rows(r,rows,'pressurewide',cameras=('practice_cam','side_cam'),video='both')
    elif args.phase=='plan':
        _,data=build_write_rows(r,start,q); save_path_preview(data)
        print('saved /app/output/path_preview.png',flush=True)
    elif args.phase=='write':
        rows,_=build_write_rows(r,start,q)
        run_rows(r,rows,'lettering',cameras=('canvas_cam','side_cam'),video='both',fps=10)
        final=r.get_obs(cameras=['canvas_cam'],video='none')
        Image.fromarray(final.last['canvas_cam']).save('/app/output/final_canvas.png')
        print('final_status',json.dumps(r.status()),flush=True)
if __name__=='__main__': main()
